about: Each fact is a routing rule: items of a category go to the Cedar or Birch queue depending on their properties. Queries use held-out nouns.

facts.label: Travel luggage
header: Cedar if NOT red strap, otherwise Birch
facts.statement: a travel luggage goes to Cedar if it has no red strap, and to Birch otherwise
queries:
The valise is torn; has a red strap; is heavy; is not locked.
Should it be sent to the Cedar queue or the Birch queue?
Answer:
Birch
